identity.title: High-resolution Millimeter Imaging of the CI Tau Protoplanetary Disk: A Massive Ensemble of Protoplanets from 0.1 to 100 au

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present high resolution millimeter continuum imaging of the disc surrounding the young star CI Tau, a system hosting the first hot Jupiter candidate in a protoplanetary disc system.

question.value: What is the continuum structure of the CI Tau disc at high resolution, and can its annular gaps be explained by massive planets accompanying the hot Jupiter?

evidence.quote: We argue that these gaps are most likely to be generated by massive planets so that, including the hot Jupiter, the system contains four gas giant planets at an age of only 2 Myr.

method.value: envelope plus three logistic gaps, fitted to visibilities with GALARIO and emcee

We run the MCMC sampler with 120 walkers for $50\times 10^3$ steps after a burn in phase of $30\times 10^3$ steps.

fitting.value: Gaussian likelihood; uniform priors except p(i)=sin(i)

evidence.quote: We choose uniform priors on all parameters, except for inclination for which $p(i)=\sin(i)$ for $0\leq{}i\leq\pi/2$.

validation.value: Chain traces, autocorrelation time ~150 steps; residual image

evidence.quote: resulting in $\sim$150 steps on average for all parameters

analysis_steps.goal: Hydrodynamic modelling of gaps with planets

method.value: 2D FARGO3D with dust, synthetic emissivity compared to fitted profile, then synthetic image via CASA ft and CLEAN

evidence.quote: using the 2D version of the FARGO3D code (cite: fargo3d) with our implementation of drag coupled dust (cite: Rosotti2016)

results_numeric.quantity: Upper limit flux ratio inside/outside innermost gap

findings_qualitative.value: Three gaps imply planets; outer two sub-Jovian planets challenge formation models

evidence.quote: the outer two planets (sub Jovian planets at radii of $43$ and $108$ au) present a challenge to current planet formation models

claims.hypothesis: Are the three gaps caused by planets?
claims.result: Planets of 0.75, 0.15, 0.4 MJ reproduce the profile
claims.finding: CI Tau hosts four giant planets including the hot Jupiter

evidence.quote: Our dust and gas dynamical modeling satisfies every available observational constraint

claims.hypothesis: Do non-planetary mechanisms explain the gaps?

evidence.quote: We therefore focus on the planetary hypothesis.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Photoevaporation, VSI, non-ideal MHD, sublimation-front opacity effects rejected

evidence.quote: photoevaporation produces holes rather than gaps

limitations_admitted.value: Innermost gap poorly resolved; shape unconstrained

evidence.quote: Thus we cannot firmly constrain the detailed shape of the innermost gap

referee_caveats_inferred: Planet masses depend on assumed alpha; low-alpha alternative gives much lower masses
